description: Free, read-only. Fetch one XML sitemap and return JSON. A urlset gives urls[] (loc, lastmod, changefreq, priority, plus image/news extensions), urlCount and truncated. A sitemap index gives type 'sitemapindex' and sitemaps[] with the child URLs; children are not fetched, call again per child. Uncompressed XML only, no .gz. Errors on non-2xx, 10 s timeout or private hosts.

maxUrls.description: Default 100, max 1000; urlCount still reports the full total. Ignored for a sitemap index.

url.description: sitemap.xml or sitemap index URL, http(s), uncompressed.

name: sitemap_parse
title: Parse sitemap
